beats.text: Hanuman flew over the ocean like a comet. The ocean god raised the golden mountain Mainaka from the waves to let him rest.
Hanuman only touched it with his hand in thanks. 'I cannot rest until I find Sita,' he said.
The gods tested Hanuman on his flight. First, the sea-serpent Surasa rose with a huge open mouth. 'No one passes without entering my mouth.'
Hanuman grew larger, and her mouth grew larger. Ten yojanas. Twenty. Ninety.
Then he shrank to the size of a thumb, flew in and slipped out through her jaws. She smiled and blessed him.
Next, Simhika, a demoness who caught creatures by their shadows, grabbed his shadow and dragged him down.
Hanuman broke free from her grip and flew on.
The sea was clear. Ahead, on the horizon, golden Lanka began to shine.
